headline: Catawba and Lincoln Memorial take the first conference wins
dek: Catawba have scored nine and conceded three without losing, and seven different players have scored for them. Lincoln Memorial took the opening conference round's other win, and Wingate's goal was breached for the first time this season.
displaced_by: Conference play opened on 2026-09-05 and Wingate conceded at Lincoln Memorial, so the standing lede was no longer true.

pattern.label: observed
pattern.text: Mars Hill's thirteen goals are spread across eight different scorers, and no one of them has more than Logan Knight's four.

wire.line: Only Anderson and Catawba remain unbeaten; Emory & Henry still have no published result at all.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Four matches whose dates have passed carry no result: Newberry's opening pair and both of Emory & Henry's. Emory & Henry have therefore played nothing the record can show.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: One match has a published result and no reachable box score, and it is Carson-Newman's: the home defeat by Trevecca, whose detail the collector could not tie to the date.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Newberry have lost all three of the matches that carry a result, scoring once and conceding nine. Giuseppe Gereau is the only player to have scored for them.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Lenoir-Rhyne have scored eight and conceded ten, and remain without a win: two draws, two defeats.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Anderson's Asher Risell has kept two clean sheets and conceded one goal.

last_match.line: Catawba remain unbeaten; Newberry have yet to take a point from any match.

next_match.line: Anderson are unbeaten; Coker have yet to score a goal this season.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
